D: Batman goes after Superman while Lex Luthor plays them against each other.
P: Serve the drinks when Lex hands over the jar of peach tea at the hearing.
S: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, figs with goat's cheese and honey
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche, and figs with goat's cheese and honey, on silver trays.

Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg and spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with sour cream. Mix 100g self-raising flour with 1 egg, 100ml milk, half a teaspoon smoked paprika and salt into a thick batter. Stir in the kernels from 3 corn cobs and 3 sliced spring onions. Heat 5mm of oil in a frying pan and drop in tablespoons of batter, cooking 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped chives and lime zest and serve with the hot fritters.
Rye crispbread with creme fraiche, smoked trout, pickled onion and dill
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with flaked smoked trout, thin pickled onion and dill.
M: Beef fillet wrapped in mushrooms, prosciutto and puff pastry

Beef fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and puff pastry, baked golden and carved into thick slices for Lex's library gala. Sear a 1kg beef fillet all over and brush with mustard. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms with garlic until dry. Lay prosciutto on puff pastry, spread with mushrooms, wrap the beef, brush with egg and bake at 210C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.
Lois and Clark at the Daily Planet

Club sandwiches of grilled chicken, crisp bacon, avocado and tomato on toasted bread with mayo, stacked three high and cut into triangles. Season 2 chicken breasts, grill 6 minutes a side and slice. Cook 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread 4 slices with mayo and layer with chicken, sliced tomato and lettuce. Add a second slice of toast, spread with mayo, and layer with bacon and sliced avocado. Top with a third slice, push 4 toothpicks through and cut each into 4 triangles. Serve with potato crisps.
W: Dark chocolate soufflés baked in ramekins

Hot dark chocolate soufflés risen tall above the ramekins, served straight from the oven with a jug of cold cream to pour in the middle. Butter and sugar 4 ramekins. Melt 150g dark chocolate, stir in 3 egg yolks. Whisk 4 egg whites with 60g sugar to soft peaks, fold in and fill the ramekins. Bake at 190C for 12 minutes and serve with 200ml cream.
K: LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz
Pear nectar and fresh ginger syrup in a flute, topped up with bubbles

Pear nectar, fresh ginger syrup and a squeeze of lemon, topped with chilled sparkling wine and a twist of candied ginger on the rim. Simmer 100g sliced fresh ginger with 100g caster sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, then strain and cool. Into four chilled flutes pour 60ml pear nectar, 20ml ginger syrup and 10ml lemon juice each. Top each with about 100ml cold sparkling wine and stir once gently. Thread a piece of candied ginger onto a pick and rest it across each glass.

steps.text: Halve the figs and tear the salmon into small folds.
Top each blini with creme fraiche and smoked salmon.
Top each fig half with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey.
Arrange both on silver trays.
Slice a few pickled onions into rings and pick the dill into sprigs.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Flake the trout over the top and finish with onion rings and dill.
Serve cold on a slate.
Chop the mushrooms very fine and crush the garlic.
Sear the beef all over in hot oil, then brush with mustard and cool.
Cook the mushrooms with garlic until dry.
Lay prosciutto on a pastry sheet, spread with mushrooms and wrap around the beef, sealing with the second sheet. Brush with egg.
Bake at 210C.
Rest before slicing.
Butter and sugar four ramekins and heat the oven to 190C.
Melt the chocolate and stir in three yolks.
Whisk the four whites with sugar to soft peaks and fold into the chocolate.
Fill the ramekins and bake.
Serve straight away with cream.

s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon. Halve 6 fresh figs, top each with a little goat's cheese and drizzle with honey. Arrange both on silver trays and hand them round like a billionaire's library gala.
